About Me

I'm a Computer Science student at October 6 University in Cairo, expected to graduate in 2027, with hands-on experience in IT help desk support, network configuration, and hardware troubleshooting. I'm currently training as a Penetration Testing Trainee with DEPI (Digital Egypt Pioneers Initiative) on the Vulnerability Analyst & Penetration Tester track, while also working toward my CCNA and getting practical exposure to firewall concepts, CCTV systems, and embedded IoT hardware.
